subject: CloudHarbor RFI — assurance playbook & evidence scaffold
messages:
From: Maria Velazquez <maria.velazquez@cloudharbor.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: J. Singh <jsingh@cloudharbor.com>, procurement@cloudharbor.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / SIG details needed for procurement review

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is moving CloudHarbor's vendor review into the formal RFI stage; attached is our control catalog extract and the SIG questionnaire kernel we need answered for our security committee. High level ask: a concise mapping to SOC 2 controls (Type II) and ISO 27001 references, and a named list of artifacts we can request for each claim.

Can you confirm Redwood can return a first-pass mapping and a prioritized evidence scaffold by next Wednesday (25 July)? The procurement team wants a short playbook showing minimal artifact set for an initial procurement approval, and then the full evidentiary package for our security review.

Attachments: CloudHarbor_Control_Catalog.xlsx (excerpt), SIG-questionnaire-kernel.pdf

Best,
Maria Velazquez
Head of Vendor Risk — CloudHarbor Systems

---
Note: If helpful, J. Singh (cc) will join a short call to clarify any control scoping assumptions.
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Velazquez <maria.velazquez@cloudharbor.com>
Cc: J. Singh <jsingh@cloudharbor.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFI: SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / SIG details needed for procurement review

Hi Maria —

Appreciate the clear ask and the attachments. We can produce the two deliverables you outlined:
- "assurance playbook" (one-page summary + 2-level control mapping) that will list the minimal artifacts to unblock procurement; and
- "evidence scaffold" (spreadsheet) that maps SIG questions to Redwood control assertions, SOC 2 Type II section references, ISO 27001 clause references, and the named artifact(s) we can deliver.

Plan / commitments:
1) Draft assurance playbook by EOD Monday (23 Jul) for review.
2) Evidence scaffold first-pass by EOD Wednesday (25 Jul).
3) If needed, follow-up 30 minute call Thurs (26 Jul) to triage any high-priority evidence requests before your security committee meeting.

I've looped in Neha (security programs) to handle the mapping and artifact inventory, and Markus from compliance for the SOC2/ISO references. If you prefer, we can keep the initial playbook intentionally minimal (3–5 artifacts) so procurement can move forward quickly.

Thanks — we'll get started and flag any questions early.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Velazquez <maria.velazquez@cloudharbor.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft evidence scaffold (initial upload)

Maria / Grace —

Attached is our initial evidence scaffold export (CSV) and an abbreviated control-to-question mapping. Highlights:
- For SIG sections where Redwood relies on third-party cloud provider controls, we've flagged items as "third-party-substantiation" and listed the recommended Cloud Provider artifact (e.g., CSP SOC reports, CSA STAR).
- Minimal playbook (for procurement): 4 artifacts we recommend Redwood supply immediately: SOC 2 Type II report (2027), encrypted backup policy & rotation proof, production network zone diagram (redacted), and our most recent penetration test executive summary.
- Full artifact list includes operational logs and process runbooks; we will not push raw logs unless there's an NDA/limited-scope evidence transfer.

Attachments (in this thread): CloudHarbor_RFI_Control_Catalog.xlsx (annotated), evidence_collection_template.csv, Redwood_SOC2-Type2-2027.pdf

Open question: J. Singh flagged a SIG item about key lifecycle for HSM-backed keys used for customer KMS integration. We believe the evidence required is: key rotation policy, KMS configuration snapshot, and HSM audit summary. Markus — can you confirm whether we can provide a redacted HSM audit summary or if we should supply an HSM attestation stub instead?

Neha Kapoor
Security Programs — Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Maria Velazquez <maria.velazquez@cloudharbor.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft evidence scaffold (initial upload)

Folks —

Quick confirmation: Redwood can provide the SOC 2 Type II report (attached), ISO 27001 control mappings, and a redacted HSM audit summary. We will not provide raw hardware audit logs. For the HSM item, supply:
- Redacted HSM audit summary (covering rotation events, tamper logs, and attestation dates)
- KMS configuration snapshot with customer-specific keys masked
- Key rotation policy (versioned)

Also note: delivering the SOC 2 report and redacted HSM summary will require an access agreement for CloudHarbor's security reviewers. Grace — I'll draft the non-disclosure evidence access addendum and circulate it for signature today, unless you want Legal to handle.

Markus Klein
Head of Compliance — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Velazquez <maria.velazquez@cloudharbor.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudHarbor RFI — assurance playbook & evidence scaffold

Maria —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our commitments:
- Attached is the one-page Assurance Playbook (PDF) and the evidence scaffold CSV.
- We recommend starting procurement with the 4 minimal artifacts Neha listed; once the access addendum is in place we'll stage the SOC2 and redacted HSM summary in a secure share.

Proposed next steps:
1) Maria — confirm acceptance of the evidence access addendum by EOD Thu (27 Jul).
2) If accepted, we will provision secure access and place the SOC2 report and HSM summary in the drive by Mon (30 Jul).
3) Schedule a 30 minute triage on Thu (preferred 10:00–11:00 PT) to prioritize any SIG items that will block your security committee.

Attachments: Redwood_Assurance_Playbook_CloudHarbor_20280725.pdf, evidence_scaffold_CH_HB-9821.csv

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

On a related note: Grace / Markus — legal will likely ask for a short SOW addendum to cover evidence access and retention. I'll start a stub and share it in the same Drive folder.
